_inspectorSnowReport.Report:
Saturday, April 4th, 2026 - Good Morning Skiers and Riders! This is Laurie with your snow report from 5am for Saturday, April 4th. Remember the easiest way to get up to date information is on the Ikon Pass app or website.  

 At Mid Mountain, we’ve had 2 new inches of snow in the past 24 hours, with 2 inches falling since the mountain closed yesterday.  

At the Summit, we’ve had 3 new inches of snow in the past 24 hours, with 1/2 inch falling since the mountain closed yesterday. 

Our Mid mountain base is 20 inches, the temperature is 22 degrees, the winds are 5 miles per hour from the W, with cloudy skies. 

The Summit base is 58 inches, the temperature is 15 degrees, the winds are 14 miles per hour from the W, and it’s snowing.

The base temperature is 30 degrees. 

We will be skiing and riding on 10 lifts, 21 runs, and 282 acres on PP/SP snow. 

Celebrate closing weekend today at Steamboat Resort with Bud Light Rocks the Boat, kicking off at 3:30pm in Steamboat Square with a free live concert from The Sweet Lillies. Enjoy an afternoon of high-energy bluegrass, mountain views, and that signature Ski Town, U.S.A. après vibe. Grab your crew and join the party—get all the details now at steamboat.com/events.

Stay in the know with the Ikon Pass App. Find it in the app store on your mobile device and get lift and trail statuses, conditions updates, and more. 

If you are thinking of exploring outside the ski area boundaries, and don’t know exactly where you are going, don’t go. 

Ski and Ride with Care and we will see you on the mountain!
_inspectorSnowReport.Alert: Closing Day for skiing & riding will be this Sunday, April 5. We be hosting The Splashdown Pond Skim at Rendezvous Lodge at 11am on Sunday, April 5, and we'll continue to host the final Bud Light Rocks The Boat concerts on Sunday, April 12 beginning at 2:30pm featuring Duane Betts & Palmetto Motel and The Wailers.
